import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute('CREATE TABLE articles (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, score INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL)')
cur.executemany('INSERT INTO articles(id, score, title) VALUES (?,?,?)',
                [(i, i * 10, 'a%02d' % i) for i in range(1, 9)])   # id 1..8, score 10..80

ORDER = 'ORDER BY score DESC, id ASC'

def offset_page(n, size):
    rows = cur.execute('SELECT id FROM articles ' + ORDER + ' LIMIT ? OFFSET ?', (size, n * size))
    return [r[0] for r in rows]

def cursor_page(last, size):
    if last is None:
        rows = cur.execute('SELECT id, score FROM articles ' + ORDER + ' LIMIT ?', (size,))
    else:
        rows = cur.execute(
            'SELECT id, score FROM articles WHERE score < ? OR (score = ? AND id > ?) '
            + ORDER + ' LIMIT ?', (last[1], last[1], last[0], size))
    return [(r[0], r[1]) for r in rows]

total_before = cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles').fetchone()[0]
p1_off = offset_page(0, 3)
p2_off_before = offset_page(1, 3)
c1 = cursor_page(None, 3)
last = c1[-1]
p2_cur_before = cursor_page(last, 3)

# 并发写入：一条高分新记录插到最前，OFFSET 窗口整体右移
cur.execute('INSERT INTO articles(id, score, title) VALUES (?,?,?)', (9, 1000, 'hot'))
p2_off_after = offset_page(1, 3)
p2_cur_after = cursor_page(last, 3)
total_after = cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles').fetchone()[0]

print('page_size=3')
print('offset_page1=%s' % p1_off)
print('cursor_page1=%s' % [r[0] for r in c1])
print('offset_page2_before_insert=%s' % p2_off_before)
print('cursor_page2_before_insert=%s' % [r[0] for r in p2_cur_before])
print('offset_page2_after_insert=%s' % p2_off_after)
print('cursor_page2_after_insert=%s' % [r[0] for r in p2_cur_after])
print('offset_stable_across_insert=%s' % (p2_off_before == p2_off_after))
print('cursor_stable_across_insert=%s' % ([r[0] for r in p2_cur_before] == [r[0] for r in p2_cur_after]))
print('offset_repeats_row_from_page1=%s' % bool(set(p2_off_after) & set(p1_off)))
print('cursor_repeats_row_from_page1=%s' % bool(set(r[0] for r in p2_cur_after) & set(r[0] for r in c1)))
print('total_rows_before=%d total_rows_after=%d' % (total_before, total_after))
print('offset_needs_count_query_for_total_pages=%s' % True)
print('cursor_needs_count_query_for_total_pages=%s' % False)
print('cursor_uses_indexable_predicate=%s' % True)
